rules: Corpse creation records death_original_equipped_slot only for top-level items that were equipped at death.
RestoreCorpseItems remains carried-only and removes temporary death-slot metadata.
Equipment restoration occurs only when restoreEquipment is explicitly true.
Explicit equipment restoration requires an authoritative RuntimeCharacterRecord.
Restoration reuses ordinary Equip validation for slot legality, requirements, conflicts, handedness, and broken-state checks.
Any failed equipment restoration rolls back all item, corpse, gold, and ownership changes in the restoration operation.
